title: Why Sridhar Vembu Left California for a Village in Tenkasi
conflicts: Month of the move: October 2019 (Forbes India, Hindustan Times) versus November 2019 (Deccan Herald); story uses October. First Tenkasi team: six (The Week, Outlook Business) versus 'hardly 10' (DT Next); story uses six. Mathalamparai headcount varies widely by date and outlet (200 in 2017 to 1,200 in 2025), so only the 2017 figure is used; the Hindustan Times claim that 90% of staff were in rural centres contradicts Forbes India and is dropped.
notes: Stance affirms. The slate's 'moving the company's centre' is reframed: Zoho stayed headquartered in Chennai; the episode is Vembu's personal move to lead a satellite-office plan. Founder reasoning comes from his May 2020 Forbes India interview, a few months after the move. The repeat screen flagged three unrelated editions as same-founder (fuzzy match) and let it through.
